app.mode.heat.label: Heat
app.mode.heat.title: Additive heat: every visible row contributes a camera-facing radial ramp

app.mode.difference.title: Signed heat: one set of teams adds, the other subtracts
app.mode.teamHeat.label: Team heat
app.mode.teamHeat.title: Heat coloured by group: one hue per group, mixed where groups overlap, opacity still carrying density
app.mode.boxReplay.label: Box replay
app.mode.boxReplay.title: A box per person, interpolated along the timeline — playback rather than density
app.mode.lineHeat.label: Lines
app.mode.lineHeat.title: Line heat: a line from each of a person's samples to their next, between the events that start and end a route, with the heat falling off sideways - where people went rather than where they stood
